text:
jess: Quick pulse — RC surge + shadow-checks for the SDK/docs/quickstarts release. We need final owners and a changelog cutoff. Can owners shout if they can take point? :wave:

kai: I can own SDK + packaging checks. Will run a final binary size pass and confirm PRs merged. ETA EOD today.

maria: I’ll take docs + quickstarts. I want 1) README smoke, 2) quickstart CI artifacts, 3) publish notes. Planning a docs sweep at 16:00 PT.

jess: Awesome, thanks @kai and @maria. @tom can you own sampleapps + sample CI? We still have 2 flaky tests in sampleapp-integration.

tom: Yep I’ll triage the two failing tests. I’ve got a local repro. Will open a patch and request review. If I can’t fix, will revert the flaky test only with a clear TODO.

elaine: Changelog cutoff question — do we set cutoff at the merge baseline or the release branch creation? Suggest we cut on branch creation to keep PR noise out.

jess: Agreed — branch creation. I’ll create rc/devex-1.4.0 in ~10m. Set cutoff env so CI enforces it.

jess: Branch created: rc/devex-1.4.0
```
CHANGELOG_CUTOFF=2026-03-18T23:59:00Z
RELEASE_BRANCH=rc/devex-1.4.0
```

maria: I’ll freeze any doc PRs that touch quickstarts after that cutoff. If someone needs urgent doc fixes, ping me and I’ll triage.

kai: SDK note — I saw a failing integration in v2 client tests on macos-latest. I’ll re-run CI matrix and push a patch.

ci-bot: ci/devex-sdk #342 — macos-latest re-run requested by kai — all checks queued.

devex-bot: release-checklist updated: owners={sdk:kai, docs:maria, sampleapps:tom}, changelog_cutoff=2026-03-18T23:59:00Z, publish-window=2026-03-19T02:00Z-06:00Z

tom: Quick ask — who can review sampleapp PR #559 when I’m ready? I might need a fast approve to avoid blocking the release window.

elaine: I can do a quick review after your patch lands; ping me in the PR and on this thread.

jess: Plan summary: owners locked (kai, maria, tom), branch + cutoff set, docs freeze on cutoff, sample CI triage in progress. If blockers emerge we do a small patch-only cutoff and hold release. :thumbsup:

kai: Noted. I’ll post a final status update once macos run is green.

maria: I’ll post docs smoke results after 16:30 PT.

tom: Will aim to have sampleapp PR ready by 15:30 PT and request review from @elaine.

jess: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single-source update. If anything changes, please add a one-line update here.

devex-bot: Reminder: changelog bot will block merges after cutoff. Be prepared to file follow-ups for post-cut changes.

kai: macos run fixed, pushed patch, CI passing now.

ci-bot: ci/devex-sdk #342 — all checks passed — mergeable.

maria: Docs smoke looks good — quickstart steps run in a clean VM, no broken links in the new pages.

tom: Sampleapp PR #559 merged after small fix. All sample CI green.

jess: Release window still on. I’ll kick off the publish job at 02:00Z tomorrow. If anyone sees regressions in the next 4 hours, speak up here.

elaine: LGTM. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
